baseline: v1.4 source archive 76 missions; release candidate must report its actual mission count

gates.name: source and reproducibility
checks: Clean checkout or unmodified extracted source
No unreconciled changes to missions and save schema

gates.name: contracts and tests
checks: All applicable existing game tests pass
All newly added adapter/action tests pass
No flaky test without ticket and quarantine note

gates.name: progress compatibility
checks: Schema-2, schema-3, schema-4 disposable fixture load and backups

gates.name: Windows native integration
checks: Extracted launcher starts on actual Windows x64
Offline clean launch with bundled runtime

gates.name: UX and performance
checks: No P0 overlap or stuck player/door
Frame p95 budget on reference hardware or documented waiver approved before release

gates.name: artifact integrity
checks: Source ZIP and Windows ZIP version/commit match
Extract and launch from clean folder
Full test report includes exceptions and hardware

stop_ship: data loss or unbacked save migration
unhandled false pass from untrusted worker output
launcher not startable on clean Windows
required medical content implied to be clinical
